additional_info.subject: [Wheeltainer] Request for Investigation on Charging Station MP/R6 170002001 (Charger ID: 4HIbKg)
additional_info.body:
Hello,
I would like to request an investigation regarding a malfunction that occurred on
May 9th, 2025
on charging station
MP/R6 170002001 (Charger ID: 4HIbKg)
, when both
DC1
and
DC3
connectors were in use simultaneously.
The client reported that while starting to charge a tractor, a vehicle identified as
GM-752-YP
, which was already charging on
DC1
, got
disconnected unexpectedly
.
Below are the session details:
DC1 Connector
Charging Start
: 09/05/2025 at 12:53:54
Charging End
: 09/05/2025 at 13:17:05
Charging Duration
: 00:23:11
Energy Consumed
: 68.52 kWh
SoC at End
: 45%
Stop Reason
:
Error occurred during charging
DC3 Connector (tractor charged by the client)
Charging Start
: 09/05/2025 at 13:13:34
Charging End
: 09/05/2025 at 16:22:03
Charging Duration
: 03:08:28
Energy Consumed
: 262.34 kWh
The session completed successfully
It appears that starting the session on DC3 caused the ongoing session on DC1 to be interrupted, although both connectors are expected to operate independently.
Could you please analyze this incident and provide the following:
The exact cause of the interruption on DC1
Whether a power management conflict or dynamic allocation error was involved
Corrective actions to ensure that an active session is not interrupted by the start of another
Please let me know if you need any additional information.
Best regards,
Malek DRIF | Head of Operations | Mob: +33 650 370 485
SAS AUTORECHARGE |
WWW.AUTORECHARGE.FR
|
+33 970 755 400
Design and installation of EV charging equipment and infrastructure
.

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0423937-DC/Si-D/FR-[MP / R6 170002001] Request for Investigation on Charging Station CRM:02681000157
additional_info.body:
Dear Malek Drif,
Hope you are doing well.
As per the timestamp provided, we have analyzed the charger logs and observed that the contactor was in an abnormal state, which led to the charging session being stopped.
Please refer to the logs below, where it is evident that the session was interrupted due to a contactor feedback issue:
2025-05-09T11:13:11.646535+00:00 swcpu [user:debug] [4021] [SCO] OGC[0]: DC1-DC1_QA21-22, COMMAND: on, FEEDBACK: off, BLOCKING: yes, OPRSTATE: AbNormal(off FBK while on), CHRGOPRMODE: 6, CTRL_DC_UNIT: DC1
2025-05-09T11:13:13.650253+00:00 swcpu [user:debug] [4021] [SCO] OGC[0]: DC1-DC1_QA21-22, COMMAND: on, FEEDBACK: off, BLOCKING: yes, OPRSTATE: AbNormal(on FBK Timeout), CHRGOPRMODE: 6, CTRL_DC_UNIT: DC1
2025-05-09T11:13:15.897278+00:00 swcpu [user:debug] [4021] [DCC] DC1: Charging Phase "P06_CHARGE" --> "P00_UNKNOWN"
Additionally, the error logs indicate that PowerConverter[3] did not perform the expected fast shutdown.
We also observed error
E17
, which corresponds to an
Internal Communication Error
.
About persisting error, we will reach out to regional team to take the further course of action.
We thank you for your time and patience in advance.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team - Abhinav Malokar
